goal: Allow users and external wallets to manually protect block height ranges from automatic pruning via RPC
Prevent pruned nodes from deleting blocks needed for future wallet rescans during downtime
agreement: Concept approval for enabling external wallets to build on pruned nodes (achow101, stickies-v)
Full review approval after safety and interface changes (sedited)
Unaddressed objection: startup pruning deletes blocks before -prunelockheight registers (shuv-amp)

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because it provides a new interface for external wallets to manage block retention on pruned nodes
Protects needed rescans and blocks without forcing clients to manually reimplement automatic pruning
